title: The road so far.
subtitle: Three years of shipping production software, from quiet internal tools to public-facing products.

items.summary: Owned full-stack delivery on a cluster of internal and client-facing products. Lived in the seam between product, design, and engineering.
highlights: Designed and shipped full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
Built an admin panel from scratch for managing users, roles, permissions, and live system data.
Led a report analysis tool with multi-source ingestion, aggregations, and drill-down dashboards.
Mentored junior engineers on Git workflows, code review, and modern React patterns.

items.summary: Worked alongside a tight cross-functional team on animated marketing sites and internal dashboards.
highlights: Built animated, responsive web apps using React, GSAP, and Tailwind.
Integrated authentication, file storage, and database flows end-to-end.
Wired up forms and APIs into seamless multi-step user journeys.
Optimised page weight and animation timing for sub-second interactions.

education.title: Self-driven engineering education
education.subtitle: 2021 — present
education.body: Hundreds of hours of building, breaking, and reading source code. Specialised in modern React, distributed systems fundamentals, and 3D for the web.
